processes.transport_contract_amendment_approval: Account director approves a customer's request to change a transportation contract quantity or MDQ and forwards it to scheduling or contract staff to amend.
processes.california_capacity_weekly_report: Weekly compilation and email of California deliveries, capacity utilization and posted gas prices for the commercial team.
processes.pipeline_imbalance_reconciliation: Gathering, checking and sending imbalance and scheduled-volume support data to reconcile with counterparties and internal groups.
processes.time_report_submission: Reporting absences and submitting time reports in reply to administrative reminders.
processes.capacity_bid_notification: Notifying customers of available capacity postings and bid deadlines with the EBB link.
processes.realtime_desk_instructions: Desk lead sends trading and scheduling instructions to real-time power traders covering deal booking, lending, tagging and market changes.
